scenarios.title: 1. Verify evaluation panel shows full pre-change details
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that when evaluation data is available, the evaluation panel includes the review model string along with cohort and date, as per the pre-patch behavior.

scenarios.title: 3. Verify 'Generate Playwright plan' button disabled without API ready
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the 'Generate Playwright plan' button is disabled when the API status is not ready, matching pre-change behavior.

scenarios.title: 4. Verify 'Analyze change' button disabled with no PR URL and diff
scenarios.purpose: Check that the 'Analyze change' button is disabled when required inputs are missing and API is not ready, as per pre-change state.

scenarios.title: 5. Verify inline setup hint is visible when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the setup hint prompting configuration of OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL is visible when API is not ready, consistent with pre-change behavior.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
